sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Falkland Islands Public Holidays 2026 - 2029
sources.said: New Year's Day: Thursday 1st January (2026), Friday 1st January (2027), Monday 3rd January (in lieu of) (2028), Monday 1st January (2029); Good Friday: 3rd April, 26th March, 14th April, 30th March; Liberation Day (14th June): Monday 15th June (in lieu of), Monday 14th June, Wednesday 14th June, Thursday 14th June; Peat Cutting Monday (First Monday in October): 5th, 4th, 2nd, 1st October; HM The King’s Birthday (14th November): Monday 16th November (in lieu of), Monday 15th November (in lieu of), Tuesday 14th November, Wednesday 14th November; Battle Day (8th December): Tuesday 8th, Wednesday 8th, Friday 8th, Monday 10th December (in lieu of); Christmas Day: Friday 25th, Monday 27th (in lieu of), Monday 25th, Tuesday 25th; Boxing Day: Monday 28th (in lieu of), Tuesday 28th (in lieu of), Tuesday 26th, Wednesday 26th; Christmas Holiday (27th December): Tuesday 29th (in lieu of), Wednesday 29th (in lieu of), Wednesday 27th, Thursday 27th. * These two days are not public holidays; they are days on which all Government Departments (other than those providing essential services) will be closed. ... When a Public Holiday falls either on Saturday or Sunday, the holiday is carried over to the Monday.
